name: herdr-paseo-bridge
description: Use the same native Codex, Claude Code and Pi sessions in Herdr and Paseo.

scripts.release: npm run check:version && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node dist/scripts/release.js
scripts.dev: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/dev.ts
scripts.native:upgrade: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/native-upgrade.ts
scripts.claude:wire: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/claude-wire-check.ts
scripts.claude:dev: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/claude-native-dev.ts
scripts.claude:start: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/claude-native-start.ts
scripts.pi:dev: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/pi-native-dev.ts
scripts.pi:start: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/pi-native-start.ts
scripts.pi:question: node --import tsx scripts/pi-question-check.ts
